preconditions.description: Input must contain exactly two integers n (number of vertices) and m (number of edges) where 2 ≤ n ≤ 100000 and 1 ≤ m ≤ 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 2 and 1 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= n and 1 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= n for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next m lines must contain exactly two integers u and v (1 ≤ u, v ≤ n) representing an undirected edge, with no self-loops or multiple edges.
The graph must have at least one edge (m ≥ 1).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) >= 2 and all(line.strip() for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: If no valid partition exists, output must be exactly '-1'. Otherwise, output must describe two disjoint vertex covers A and B, each described by a line with k (number of vertices) followed by k vertex indices.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('-') for v in line.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All vertex indices in the output must be valid (1 ≤ v ≤ n).
The two vertex covers A and B must be disjoint (no overlapping vertices).

postconditions.expression: (stdout.strip() != '-1') and all(any(int(u) in set(stdout.split()[1:][:int(stdout.split()[0])]) or int(v) in set(stdout.split()[1:][:int(stdout.split()[0])]) for u, v in edges) and any(int(u) in set(stdout.split()[1:][int(stdout.split()[0])+1:]) or int(v) in set(stdout.split()[1:][int(stdout.split()[0])+1:]) for u, v in edges)
postconditions.description: Both A and B must be vertex covers: every edge must have at least one endpoint in A and at least one endpoint in B.
